findings.evidence: Line 291 `L.form.dualSubmodule L.dualCarrier = L.carrier`; `def dualCarrier (L : IntegralLattice V)` at line 155. Mathlib precedent: `LinearMap.BilinForm.dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_flip_of_basis` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/DualLattice.lean:117).

findings.issue: `span_range_extendOfIsLattice`, `dualSubmoduleToDual_surjective`, `dualSubmoduleEquivDual`, `dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_flip`, `dualSubmodule_flip_dualSubmodule` (lines 66, 82, 116, 124, 138) are statements about Mathlib's `LinearMap.BilinForm`/`Basis`, but live in the root `TauCeti` namespace. findings.evidence: Basic.lean:138 `theorem integralForm_cast (L) (x y : L) : (L.integralForm x y : ℚ) = L.form x y`; Dual.lean:201-203 `theorem intCast_dualPairing_apply … : (L.dualPairing x y : ℚ) = L.form x y`.
findings.fix: Pick one convention across the IntegralLattice namespace: rename the two new lemmas to `dualPairing_cast` / `dualPairingEquiv_cast`, or rename `integralForm_cast` to `intCast_integralForm_apply` in this PR (no compatibility alias needed).

summary: Two double-duality lemma names contradict Mathlib's own ordering convention (and the file's own general versions), and one names an operation that does not exist; five Mathlib-level lemmas about `LinearMap.BilinForm`/`Basis` sit in the root `TauCeti` namespace with names that only parse inside those Mathlib namespaces; the new cast lemmas diverge from the adjacent `integralForm_cast`.
